sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new family of models, including Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8 -Max. Qwen3.8 has thinking capabilities and a 256K context window (up to 1M tokens). Qwen3.8-27B, the upcoming 27B parameter model will be released this week. Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is a 2.4T parameter open-weight model (95B active) that rivals GPT-5.6 Sol.

sources.title: Unsloth Shrinks Qwen3.8-2.4T to 397GB via Dynamic Quantization
sources.snippet: The ability to run a 2.4T MoE model locally means that data privacy, latency, and cost-per-token are no longer the primary trade-offs for those with the right hardware. The momentum is only accelerating, as the Qwen development team is expected to release the Qwen3.8-27B model later this week, further expanding the toolkit for local AI deployment.

sources.title: Qwen3 - How to Run & Fine-tune | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Run & fine-tune the latest model: Qwen-2507 All uploads use Unsloth Dynamic 2.0 for SOTA 5-shot MMLU and KL Divergence performance, meaning you can run & fine-tune quantized Qwen LLMs with minimal accuracy loss. We also uploaded Qwen3 with native 128K context length. Qwen achieves this by using YaRN to extend its original 40K window to 128K.
